extracted.name: S'mores Cookies
extracted.description: A graham cracker and honey base, with a chocolate and marshmallow center. Topped with even more chocolate and graham cracker.
ingredient_lines: 1 large pack Graham crackers (crushed to powder)
instruction_lines: Make sure the butter is softened, then mix with brown sugar until creamy.
Add egg, yolk, vanilla, and honey. Mix well.
Stir in flour, graham cracker dust, baking soda, and baking powder.
Wrap dough around each frozen marshmallow to form 9 large cookies. Then top each cookie with a piece of semi-sweet chocolate.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 10-12 minutes until golden.
Melt chocolate chips with coconut oil, drizzle over cookies.
